messages:
sam: Quick UX sync  new ideas for reducing high-permission key mistakes: introduce a 'safety slider' when selecting Admin scopes + more visible environment chips next to each key. Mock: https://staging.redwood.local/mock/safety-slider-2234567890.png

maria: Safety slider sounds promising. How would it interact with templates? We should gray out full-admin if a template enforces read-only. :thinking_face: 

lee: Implementation notes: slider would send a numeric 'risk_score' to the API (0-100). Server validates against org policy. We should debounce interactions and only send on commit. Also environment chips are cheap, just include 'env_hint' in list API.

ada: Accessibility nits: the slider needs aria-valuemin/valuemax/valuenow and an accessible label like 'Permission safety level'. For the env chip, ensure contrast >= 4.5:1 and make it keyboard-focusable if it opens a tooltip.

jules: UX thought: show a small inline warning when slider > 70: 'High-permission keys can access billing and data. Consider a lower level.' With a learn link. Make the warning non-blocking but prominent.

maria: Microcopy: prefer 'Permission level' for the slider label, and 'High permission: billing, data export' for the helper text. Keep CTAs clear: primary 'Create key' secondary 'Review scopes'.

sam: Revoke/undo pattern: keep the soft-undo shelf, but add a short teaser mention in the create flow: 'Keys can be restored for 7 days after revoke.' Might reduce accidental deletes.

lee: Backend: when slider triggers a policy violation return 422.POLICY_BLOCK and include 'allowed_ranges' so UI can show the safe area. For optimistic creates show 'Creating...' and on server reject show inline policy reason.

ada: For screen readers announce policy blocks with role="alert" so users know why creation failed. Also test slider with keyboard arrow keys, page up/down increments, and with screen-reader labels for the helper text.

jules: Small UI nit: change the env chip color from pale blue to navy outline to improve contrast. Also add a tooltip: 'Hosted vs Dedicated behavior may differ.' 

maria: Action items: (1) sam update mock with slider in the create flow and renamed microcopy. (2) lee add API errors 422.POLICY_BLOCK and env_hint to spec. (3) ada add a11y checklist for slider, chips, and policy alerts. (4) jules try a darker chip color and post updated mock.

sam: Thanks all  will push the mock + 20s Loom showing keyboard slider interactions. We can A/B test the slider vs a static warning for 3% of new orgs.
